subject: TechSavor DPA: SCCs, retention, and signature routing

Cc: legal@techsavor.com

Subject: TechSavor DPA redlines and SCCs question

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We attached our initial redlines to the DPA (TechSavor_DPA_redlines_v1.docx) — the main items we need clarification on are:

- Section 4 (SCCs): we want confirmation that Redwood will use the current EU SCCs template and provide evidence of execution for subprocessors.
- Section 5 (Retention): request to shorten retention of pseudonymized logs to 12 months (instead of 36).
- HIPAA scope: can you confirm whether PHI will ever be processed for this scope? If so, we will need a Business Associate Addendum.

We need to close the DPA by next Wednesday to hit our procurement deadlines. Can someone confirm a plan for legal redlines and signature routing? We typically sign via DocuSign.

Attachments: TechSavor_DPA_redlines_v1.docx (docx)

Best,

TechSavor

Subject: Re: TechSavor DPA redlines and SCCs question

Hi Amanda — thanks for sending these over and being explicit about the timeline.

Quick plan:
- I've looped in Marissa (legal) to review the redlines and propose counter language.
- Rishi (VP, Product) is on copy for the retention/HIPAA scoping decision.
- We can do a 30-minute call tomorrow (Tues) to walk through the key clauses if that helps. Please share availability.

Initial notes: we typically accept the EU SCCs and can provide executed agreements for subprocessors where required, but Marissa will confirm the exact evidentiary artifacts we can provide. On retention, we prefer 24 months for aggregated telemetry; we understand TechSavor is asking for 12 months — we'll propose a middle ground or compensating controls (e.g., stronger KV cache minimization and periodic purges).

I'll follow up after Marissa's review with suggested wording and the signature routing plan (DocuSign vs. countersign PDF).

Attachment: none

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <marissa.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: TechSavor DPA redlines and SCCs question

Mina / Rishi — I reviewed TechSavor_DPA_redlines_v1.docx and drafted counter-redlines (redline_changes_techsavor_v2.docx). Key points and recommended positions:

1) SCCs / subprocessors
- We will accept the EU SCCs for controller-to-processor flows. For subprocessors, we can provide our subprocessors addendum (executed POAs) and a dated list of subprocessors; we cannot provide individual subprocessors' contracts.

2) Retention (Section 5) — RISK NOTE
- TechSavor requests 12 months for pseudonymized logs. Our standard is 36 months for debugging and SOC purposes. Operational compromise: accept 24 months for this customer for telemetry/logs, with the following conditions:
  a) Redwood will implement automated purging for identifiers after 12 months where feasible;
  b) TechSavor will accept audit evidence (S3 inventory + access logs) for retention verification;
  c) For any retention shorter than 36 months, we request a limited warranty carve-out for reproducibility of debug data.

3) HIPAA
- We do not intend to process PHI for the service plan discussed. If TechSavor identifies PHI in payloads, we will follow the documented escalation path and evaluate a BAA. Recommend adding a clear clause: "Customer warrants that it will not submit PHI unless BAA is executed."

4) Signature routing
- Recommend DocuSign (preferred) using the primary signatory on the HubSpot record. If they require countersignature PDF, route to Rishi for exec signoff.

Next steps: please confirm whether you will accept the 24-month compromise and required audit evidence. If yes, I'll send the v2 redlines to Amanda and include an inline summary to speed approval.

Attachment: redline_changes_techsavor_v2.docx (docx)

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: TechSavor DPA redlines and SCCs question

Thanks Marissa — I agree with the proposed compromise on retention (24 months) with the caveats you listed. A couple of operational asks before we agree:

- Provide explicit language that requires Redwood to retain immutable audit logs for product access and system events for 36 months (these are operational logs used for incident investigations). TechSavor can have a shorter copy of application-level telemetry but we must keep audit logs for 36 months internally.
- Require TechSavor to accept an attestation and sample evidence package (S3 inventory + CloudTrail snippets) as proof of retention and deletion.

Regarding signature routing: we should offer DocuSign and also include the option to route to me for an executive signature if procurement requires it. No commercial concessions beyond the standard onboarding credits.

Approve move to send Marissa's v2 to Amanda with clear callouts.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Product
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Final counterproposal and signature route (TechSavor DPA)

Amanda — thanks for your patience. Attached is our counter-redline set (redline_changes_techsavor_v2.docx) and a summary of the concessions we can make to meet your procurement timeline.

Summary of changes we propose:
- SCCs: Accept EU SCCs; we will provide an executed subprocessors addendum and a dated list of subprocessors.
- Retention: Agree to 24 months for customer-facing pseudonymized telemetry. Redwood will:
  • implement automated purging where feasible after 12 months for identifiers;
  • retain immutable internal audit logs for 36 months for incident and audit purposes;
  • provide an evidence package (S3 inventory + CloudTrail snippets) upon reasonable request during audits.
- HIPAA: Customer warrants it will not upload PHI unless a BAA is executed. If TechSavor needs HIPAA scope, we'll evaluate and route to our compliance team.

Signature routing:
- Preferred: DocuSign (PowerForm link below).
- Alternate: If your procurement requires countersigned PDF, route countersign to Rishi Malhotra (VP, Product) after internal signatures.

DocuSign PowerForm: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/TS-2027

Requested timeline: please confirm acceptance by EOD Monday 2027-03-07 to keep the onboarding week of 2027-03-14.

Attachments (stubs): redline_changes_techsavor_v2.docx (docx), TechSavor_DPA_final_20270304.pdf (pdf)
